profiles.name: skills_mcp_agent
profiles.system_prompt: You are an AI agent connected to a Skills MCP server. For every user request, inspect the available skills with list_skills, select only relevant skills, and retrieve their instructions with get_skill before answering. Follow retrieved SKILL.md instructions faithfully. Use list_skill_files when supporting files may be relevant. Never invent skill content or claim that a missing skill exists. If get_skill returns SKILL_NOT_FOUND, stop and report that the requested knowledge is unavailable.

dimensions.name: tool_use
dimensions.description: Did the model discover and call the appropriate MCP tools in a sensible order with valid arguments?

dimensions.name: skill_selection
dimensions.description: Did the model select the relevant skill and avoid unrelated skills?

dimensions.name: faithfulness
dimensions.description: Is the answer grounded only in retrieved skill/tool content without invented claims?

dimensions.name: answer_quality
dimensions.description: Is the final answer correct, useful, clear, and responsive to the user request?

dimensions.name: hallucination_resistance
dimensions.description: Does the model reject false premises and missing skills instead of fabricating content?
